explanation: Rivoal (2012): at least one of γ and the Gompertz constant δ is transcendental. Note that `gompertzConstant` is defined as −e·∫_1^∞ e^{−t}/t dt ≈ −0.5963, which is the negative of the usual δ = e·E₁(1) ≈ 0.5963 (I checked this numerically). Transcendence is invariant under negation, so the statement is unaffected. The statement is faithful and solved.
